about.title: Building, Learning, and Improving
about.description: I’m Mehran Soufi, a Computer Engineer and Web Developer with a strong interest in building modern, fast, and user-focused web experiences. I work with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, with a focus not only on technical quality, but also on attention to detail, user experience, and maintainable project structure.
about.descriptionSecond: My approach is built around problem-solving, attention to detail, continuous learning, and effective teamwork. I see every project as an opportunity to learn, improve, and turn ideas or real-world needs into practical digital products.
